_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee Player {player_id} ee game Liar's Dice ee kɔc {num_players}.
Käŋɛɛk:
- Yin ee wɛ̈ɛ̈r, yin ee kuɔny:
  1) Cɔ̈ɔ̈l bid tɛ̈ɛ̈m ee kɔ̈k ë kɔ̈k kuɔ̈ɔ̈p, ku bïïd ee kɔ̈k ë kɔ̈k ë kuɔ̈ɔ̈p (ku bɛ̈ɛ̈i) ë bïïd yam; ee '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Yɛ̈ɛ̈l bïïd yam ee kuɔ̈ɔ̈p '[Call]'.

Yin ee yɛ̈ɛ̈l:
  - Yɛ̈ɛ̈ ee kɔ̈k ë kuɔ̈ɔ̈p ee dɛ̈ɛ̈ ee kɔ̈k ë bïïd, kuɔ̈ɔ̈p ee kɔ̈k ë bïïd ee dɛ̈ɛ̈ ee yɛ̈ɛ̈ ee dɛ̈ɛ̈.
  - Ku bɛ̈ɛ̈i, yɛ̈ɛ̈ ee dɛ̈ɛ̈ ee dɛ̈ɛ̈.
Räɛ̈ɛ̈ ee kɔ̈k ë dɛ̈ɛ̈ ee 0, ee kɔ̈k ë yɛ̈ɛ̈ ee wɛ̈ɛ̈ɛ̈. Räɛ̈ɛ̈ ee kɔ̈k ë yɛ̈ɛ̈ ee wɛ̈ɛ̈ɛ̈ ee kɔ̈k.

board.new_round:
Ciɛŋ riɛl - Kɛm de wäär: {dice_summary}
Wäär aye cɛɛl kuɔny: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Akɛ̈ɛ̈th nhïïm raan {current_player_id} kɔ̈ɔ̈c nhïïm! Kuɛ̈të nhïïm kɔ̈ɔ̈c nhïïm raan {face_value} aye {count}, aye LESS kuɛ̈të {quantity}.
Akɛ̈ɛ̈th nhïïm raan {loser_id} (akɛ̈ɛ̈th nhïïm kɔ̈ɔ̈c nhïïm) aye tɛ̈ɛ̈ŋë nhïïm kɔ̈ɔ̈c nhïïm.
call.caller_loses:
Akɛ̈ɛ̈th nhïïm raan {current_player_id} kɔ̈ɔ̈c nhïïm! Kuɛ̈të nhïïm kɔ̈ɔ̈c nhïïm raan {face_value} aye {count}, aye >= kuɛ̈të {quantity}.
Akɛ̈ɛ̈th nhïïm raan {loser_id} (akɛ̈ɛ̈th nhïïm kɔ̈ɔ̈c nhïïm) aye tɛ̈ɛ̈ŋë nhïïm kɔ̈ɔ̈c nhïïm.

action.bid_announce: Akɛ̈ɛ̈th nhïïm raan {player_id} kɔ̈ɔ̈c nhïïm {quantity} kɔ̈ɔ̈c nhïïm raan {face_value}.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Luɔ̈i cï looi ke cïn kë cë kɔn lueel.
invalid_move.invalid_bid: Kë cë gam/të cïn kë cï lueel: {reason}
invalid_move.not_recognized: Ciɛŋ aye kɛm cɔl kuɔny '[Bid: X, Y]' '[Call]'. Ciɛŋ aye cɛɛl: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Kä yam {new_quantity} aye tɔ̈u piny tënë kä thɛɛr {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Kë ye cɔlë New face value {new_face_value} atɔ̈u piny tënë kë tɔ̈ thïn ëmɛɛn {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Kë ye gam ë ɣɔɔc ee thöŋ kek kë cï gäm kɔc.
bid_reason.face_range: Kë ye nyuɔɔth adhil rot looi në kaam de 1 ku 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: Raan ye gɔ̈ɔ̈r {player_id} acï bɛ̈n cuɛt piny në kë cïï yen lɔtueŋ.

outcome.win: Raam {winner} aye wɔn! Ciɛŋ de wäär: {final_ranking}
